admission.justification: Treating absent event history as an empty turn would lose hand-over evidence and could send a silent-turn wake for work that already handed over.

applicability: Parent-wake handling for agent.turn.after on the product’s pinned Paseo 0.16.2 host.
conditions: The 0.16.2 SDK event exposes agent identity, available turn identity and outcome. The server wire payload adds an empty timeline for compatibility.
The adapter requests the whole held timeline with direction tail and limit 0, restores each supplied row turn ID and passes null on a failed read.
exclusions: A failed refetch supplies no hand-over evidence and does not establish a turn without text.
The host-free assertions establish the contributed handler’s behavior without asserting a live plugin load or host delivery.

evidence: plugin tests 250 pass / 1 skip ("Paseo 0.15.4 hook shape: the turn read through refetch recognises a hand-over"); notes/reports/260928-MIK-L60-evidence/partB/step-log.md hand-over row

statement: The Paseo plugin reads the ended turn through context.paseo.agents.ref(id).timeline.refetch. The pinned SDK event exposes no turn history, and a refetched hand-over still counts for its own turn.
